visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) A young male with dark curly hair wearing a white Los Angeles Dodgers-themed t-shirt stands outdoors at night. He is chewing on a dark-colored meat skewer with a concentrated expression. The background is a brightly lit night market with various stall signs featuring traditional characters and yellow lighting. (2) The man turns away from the camera to reveal the back of his white t-shirt, which features a large blue and white graphic of two baseball players and the text 'LOS ANGELES'. He is walking through a narrow market aisle flanked by food stalls. (3) The scene transitions to several shots of a food stall where yellow sweet potato balls are being deep-fried in a large, circular metal vat filled with bubbling oil. A vendor wearing a blue shirt and a mask is visible. (4) The man is shown again, now holding a small white paper bag. He takes a round, golden-brown sweet potato ball and eats it, nodding in approval. The scene is illuminated by bright overhead studio-like stall lights. (5) Fast-paced shots follow, showing various foods: a scallion pancake being sliced on a wooden board, and several meat and vegetable skewers grilling on a long, narrow charcoal grill. (6) The man holds a large, dark-brown grilled corn cob on a stick. He takes a large, enthusiastic bite, looking directly into the camera. The background remains the bustling, colorful market stalls at night. (7) Finally, the man stands in front of a bean curd (Douhua) stall with a red and yellow sign. He gestures with his hand while talking, looking slightly to the side of the camera. The lighting is warm and natural for an outdoor night setting.
